answer: The forge panel is drawn blind, the nebula escrow settles at close, and ivory lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 21% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 65 account operation therefore ties up 9 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
